subject: sentences
title: Magic e sentences
about: Fifteen sentences that add CKLA Unit 2 spellings (ee and the magic-e long vowels a_e, i_e, o_e, u_e) and the Unit 2 tricky words he, she, we, me, be, they, their, my, by, you, your. Expected around November.
tip: If he reads a magic-e word short (cap for cape), point to the e and say the e makes the vowel say its name.

cards.text: We like to bake a cake.
cards.note: magic e in like, bake and cake; we: the e says its name

cards.text: She has a bike and a kite.
cards.note: magic e in bike and kite; she: the e says its name

cards.text: He can see the green tree.
cards.note: ee says long e in see, green and tree; he: the e says its name

cards.text: I have a cute pup at home.
cards.note: magic e in cute and home; have: the e makes no sound

cards.text: The snake hid by the rock.
cards.note: magic e in snake; by: the y says long i

cards.text: They sleep in a big tent.
cards.note: ee in sleep; they: ey says long a
magic e in gave and rose; rose: the s says /z/; me: the e says its name

cards.text: The mule can jump the gate.
cards.note: magic e in mule and gate

cards.text: My feet got wet in the lake.
cards.note: ee in feet; magic e in lake; my: the y says long i
magic e in wave; you: says yoo; me: the e says its name. A question: let his voice go up
magic e in Dave, five and cubes; the s on cubes says /z/

cards.text: The queen bee has a hive.
cards.note: qu and ee in queen; ee in bee; magic e in hive

cards.text: Their cat sleeps on the bed.
cards.note: their: sounds like there; ee in sleeps

cards.text: Your bike is by the shed.
cards.note: your: says yor; magic e in bike; by: the y says long i

cards.text: I will be home at nine.
cards.note: be: the e says its name; magic e in home and nine
